package.name: rosidl_typesupport_tickle_c_tests_dep
package.description: A second minimal real ROS 2 interface package, separate from rosidl_typesupport_tickle_c_tests itself, existing purely so that package can nest one of *this* package's own messages - proving, in real CI, that rosidl_typesupport_tickle_c_generate_interfaces.cmake's own cross- package -I wiring (rmw_tickle/PLAN.md's own Milestone for it) actually resolves, compiles, and links a genuinely cross-package nested message field, not just a same-package sibling (Milestone 40's own test_msgs/Nested.msg already covers that case, but a same-package reference never exercises this cross-package machinery at all). Not meant to ship or be depended on by anything else beyond that one purpose.
